items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: the old Mardi Gras Indian song. Yeah. Pacafinoja.

ctx.x: But those words had to come out of your mouth. Did you know a lot of those? I like the Creole tunes. I mean, you know...
No, well, the words I put there was from the old Indian song, the old Mardi Gras Indian song. Yeah. Pacafinoja.
